name: Whisper-asr
description: GPU accelerated Whisper ASR Webservice using the faster-whisper engine, exposing an HTTP API that returns word-level timestamps. This image ALSO contains WhisperX (word-alignment), which SubSyncarr calls directly - no separate install. Models are stored on the host (ASR_MODEL_PATH) so they are NOT baked into the docker image. The two "SubSyncarr patch" file-mappings at the bottom bind-mount SubSyncarr's patched engine files over the image's copies, which adds the multilingual=true per-segment language option to /asr and survives image upgrades (no re-apply needed). Leave those two mappings empty if you do not use SubSyncarr.

paths.name: Models
paths.description: Host folder that persists downloaded models. Keeps the model OUT of the docker image.

paths.name: SubSyncarr patch: webservice.py
paths.description: SubSyncarr multilingual patch - bind-mounts the patched file over the image's copy (adds the ?multilingual=true query param to /asr). Survives image upgrades, so no manual re-apply. Leave EMPTY if you do not use SubSyncarr.

paths.name: SubSyncarr patch: faster_whisper_engine.py
paths.description: SubSyncarr multilingual patch - bind-mounts the patched file over the image's copy (passes multilingual through to faster-whisper). Survives image upgrades. Leave EMPTY if you do not use SubSyncarr.

variables.name: ASR_ENGINE
variables.description: Engine: openai_whisper, faster_whisper, or whisperx. Use faster_whisper (it supports SubSyncarr's multilingual=true per-segment detection). WhisperX is still in the image and SubSyncarr calls its aligner directly - do NOT set this to whisperx (its engine mode currently fails at startup on this image).

variables.name: ASR_MODEL
variables.description: Model: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3. Larger = more accurate + more VRAM.

variables.name: ASR_QUANTIZATION
variables.description: Model precision: float32, float16, int8. On GPU this DEFAULTS to float32 (huge). Use int8 so large-v3 fits in ~2.5GB VRAM (needed for 6GB cards like a GTX 1660 Ti); use float16 on bigger cards for max accuracy.

variables.name: ASR_MODEL_PATH
variables.description: Where models are stored INSIDE the container. Must match the Models host-path mapping below so models persist on disk instead of bloating the docker image.

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: Which GPU(s) to expose. 'all', or a specific GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

variables.name: MODEL_IDLE_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Seconds of inactivity before the model is unloaded from VRAM (0 = keep loaded). Set e.g. 300 to free the GPU between jobs at the cost of a reload delay.
